milo.name: Milo Finch
milo.personality: An earnest, methodical neighbour who will turn any small transaction into a maths problem.
milo.delivery: Dry courtesy and carefully placed emphasis. Gets faster when the total stops making sense.

jun.name: Jun Park
jun.personality: An unflappable shopkeeper who delights in making a ridiculous rule sound like good customer service.
jun.delivery: Brisk and cheerful. Lands the oddest words as if reading the weather.
